title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space industry is buzzing with activity as governments ramp up investments in space security and resilience, while private firms continue to attract significant funding. Meanwhile, the quest for effective space traffic management grows more urgent amid rising orbital congestion.

themes.title: Funding Frenzy Continues
themes.body: Impulse Space's recent $500 million raise underscores a growing trend of capital flowing into the space sector. Meanwhile, True Anomaly's $190 million Series C reflects investor confidence in space technology's future.

themes.title: Space Traffic Management Urgency
themes.body: With the SSA market projected to hit $61 billion, the need for effective space traffic management is becoming critical. The recent discussions on equilibrium states highlight the industry's recognition of orbital safety as a priority.

themes.title: Defense Budgets on the Rise
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup adding $1.4 billion to space resilience is a clear indicator of defense priorities shifting towards space. This aligns with ongoing military collaborations, like the Anduril and L3Harris tactical SDA constellation bid.

themes.title: Innovations in Accessibility
themes.body: The UK's exploration of a space station mission for astronauts with physical disabilities marks a significant step towards inclusivity in space exploration. This initiative could pave the way for broader participation in future missions.
